column1: # Hospitals with higher federal quality ratings were paid more: $26,766 per commercial stay at 5 stars, against $13,425 at 1 star (medians).

# Source: CMS Overall Hospital Quality Star Rating (2026-07-22 release), joined by CMS number through the state facility listing. Hospitals per group: 24, 50, 59, 64, 24. A pattern, not a cause: larger teaching hospitals tend to rate higher and treat more complex cases. HCAI Hospital Measurement dataset, 2023 reporting year, computed on this site.
